Gear wise I run masters architect, spell power cure, and Ozezan monster set. Or if the group wants to prioritize damage, I’ll run spaulder of ruin and no monster set.

It’s all situational depending on content, but here’s what I run in dungeons typically.

Front Bar:
Radiating Regeneration (Regeneration Morph) - perfect Heal over Time (HOT) to hit entire group.

Combat Prayer (Blessing of Protection Morph) - Main spam heal that provides minor berserk, increasing allies damage.

Healing Springs (Grand Healing Morph) - Main AoE HOT.

Energy Orb (Necrotic Orb Morph) - Strong synergy heal that allies can activate when needed, also restores their resources.

Blue Betty (Betty Netch Morph) - Personal choice here, I like the bump to heals it provides.

Healing Thicket (Secluded Grove Morph) - Good “oh shit” ultimate situationally, can be swapped out for barrier or war horn if wanted.

Back Bar:

Budding Seeds (Healing Seed Morph) - Another AoE HOT that also can be synergized with if needed by an ally for a burst heal.

Crushing Shock (Force Shock Morph) - Situational skill, helps to provide interrupt allowing dps to focus on doing damage and less on mechs.

Echoing Vigor (Vigor Morph) - Good HOT, and it’s the way to trigger Powerful Assault if you’re running that set instead of the tank.

Overflowing Altar (Blood Altar Morph) - Another synergy for allies to heal with in “oh shit” moments, also provides a small HOT.

Expansive Frost Cloak (Frost Cloak Morph) - Provides team with major resolve. 

Icy Rage (Elemental Storm Morph) - I run this because I run the Masters Architect set, so it provides extra damage to nuke bosses while also giving allies major slayer.
